question: 所有有效订单的总销售金额是多少？
intended_meaning: 计算 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有订单的 paid_amount 总和。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 南京市的有效订单数量是多少？
intended_meaning: 统计用户所在城市为南京市的有效订单数量，需关联 users 和 orders 表，筛选 order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.city = '南京市' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 按品牌汇总有效订单的销售金额，降序排列，取前5名。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders、order_items 和 products 表，对有效订单中各品牌（products.brand）的 item_amount 求和，按总金额降序取前5。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 2026年8月的有效订单总销售金额是多少？
intended_meaning: 计算 orders 表中 order_date 在 2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31 之间且 order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped') 的 paid_amount 总和。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date <= '2026-08-31' AND order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 手机数码类商品的有效销售数量是多少？
intended_meaning: 统计 category = '手机数码' 的商品在有效订单中的销售数量总和（即 order_items.quantity 之和），需关联 orders、order_items 和 products 表。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';

question: 不同支付方式的有效订单数量分别是多少？
intended_meaning: 按 payment_method 分组，统计 orders 表中 order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单数量。
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY payment_method;

question: VIP用户的平均单笔有效订单实付金额是多少？
intended_meaning: 计算 is_vip = 1 的用户所下有效订单的 paid_amount 平均值，需关联 users 和 orders 表。
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(o.paid_amount) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.is_vip = 1 AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 七天无理由退款的申请次数是多少？
intended_meaning: 统计 refunds 表中 refund_reason = '七天无理由' 且 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录数。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE refund_reason = '七天无理由' AND refund_status = 'approved';

question: 每个城市的付费用户数（去重）是多少？按数量降序排列。
intended_meaning: 关联 orders 和 users 表，按 users.city 分组，统计 order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped') 对应的 DISTINCT user_id 数量，并按该数量降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paying_users FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY paying_users DESC;

question: 上海市的总销售金额是多少？
intended_meaning: 统计用户所在城市为上海市的有效订单的 paid_amount 总和，需关联 users 和 orders 表。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.city = '上海市' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');
